CustomField.description: Will show the total experience based on the Experience Month and Experience Year
CustomField.formula: TEXT(FLOOR(Experience_Year__c + (Experience_Month__c / 12))) & " year" & IF(FLOOR(Experience_Year__c + (Experience_Month__c / 12)) <> 1, "s", "") & IF( MOD(Experience_Month__c, 12) > 0, " " & TEXT(MOD(Experience_Month__c, 12)) & " month" & IF(MOD(Experience_Month__c, 12) <> 1, "s", ""), "" )
CustomField.label: Total Experience
